info.name: List potential vulnerabilities of your domains & IPs

params.name: labels
params.description: A case-insensitive comma separated list of website labels to filter results by

params.name: page_token
params.description: The `next_page_token` from a previous response, use this to get the next page of results.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per page.

items.docs:
Returns a list of potential vulnerabilities that have been detected for your account.

Required API key permissions: `BreachRisk` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

info.name: List potential vulnerabilities of a vendor

params.name: primary_hostname
params.description: The primary hostname of the vendor to return vulnerabilities for

items.docs:
Returns a list of potential vulnerabilities that have been detected for a particular vendor.

Required API key permissions: `VendorRisk` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)
